title: Account freeze / liquidation lock when notional exceeds the top risk segment (short can dodge liquidation)
root_cause: getRiskFactor returns (0,false) when notional exceeds the largest risk segment; Risk.getAssetValueAndRisk then reverts 'Risk: no risk' instead of clamping, freezing every position operation (incl. liquidation) on the account.
attacker_entrypoint: Oracle price move (notional=price*|amount|); attacker opens a short sized to breach the cap while underwater
attacker_capabilities: wait for / rely on price moving up (short goes underwater as notional crosses the cap)

severity_justification.worst_case: Attacker deliberately freezes an insolvent short to dodge liquidation => unrecoverable bad debt.
severity_justification.realistic_case: Any account on a pumping asset freezes (funds locked, un-liquidatable) when notional crosses the cap.
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: see official program impact table (not bundled)

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: TipRun contest (tiprun-contracts-main @ d5d4d2a); official scope list not bundled with PoC package.

call_trace: notional 12000 > cap 10000 => getRiskFactor (0,false) => Risk reverts 'Risk: no risk'
every liquidation/resize of the insolvent short reverts => un-liquidatable => bad debt

state_transition.after: price 4, equity -2000 (insolvent), all position ops revert 'Risk: no risk' (frozen/un-liquidatable)

asset_delta: Insolvent short (negative equity, e.g. -2,000) cannot be liquidated => loss is unrecoverable protocol bad debt.

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: finite top segment (normal config) => notional past it reverts instead of clamping

triager_summary: Account freeze / liquidation lock when notional exceeds the top risk segment (short can dodge liquidation) — PoC passing (PASS (2 tests): long-freeze blocks withdrawal/liquidation; short variant leaves an insolvent account un-liquidatable).
vrt_category: Blockchain → DoS with (Unexpected) revert (`getRiskFactor` returns `(0,false)` past the top risk segment → `require(riskOk,"Risk: no risk")` reverts → account frozen, including un-liquidatable → bad debt)
